selection_features: exact current broker identity and accessibility
accepted M5 history availability and schedule-adjusted completeness
cohort heterogeneity and conservative friction proxy
scope.cohort_rule: Keep the full feasible universe as the sampling frame. Select no inferential symbol unless exact identity, EUR200 feasibility, accepted contiguous M5 history, completeness, event-cluster information, and dependence support can be audited from accepted authorities. Adapt breadth to coherence and power; do not impose a fixed size, substitute structural representatives, or select from response results.

event_definition.center: Arithmetic mean of the frozen trailing lookback closes ending at the event close.
event_definition.scale: Population standard deviation of those same contiguous trailing closes.
event_definition.trigger: At a completed close, calculate z=(close-center)/scale; upper excursions are z >= threshold and lower excursions are z <= -threshold; zero-scale windows emit no event.
event_definition.cluster_unit: For each symbol, begin one excursion cluster on the first threshold crossing from inside the neutral band. Admit no repeat event while z remains in that tail; a return inside the band rearms the next cluster, and a direct crossing into the opposite tail starts a new opposite cluster.
event_definition.causal_inputs: Only exact contiguous completed M5 closes at or before the event time.

response_estimand.measure: For each predeclared horizon h, direction-adjusted forward log displacement divided by the population standard deviation of the trailing lookback's contiguous one-bar log returns ending at event time times sqrt(h); positive values indicate displacement in the reversal direction.
response_estimand.primary_unit: Independent excursion cluster, with dependence-aware UTC date/session clustering and pooled cohort inference only when outcome-blind coherence supports pooling.

hypothesis.causal_timing: Freeze event, center, scale, cohort, temporal split, missingness, power, and multiplicity rules before any response statistic; no future value may enter event admission or event-time normalization.

parameter_design.source: Reuse the already frozen Epoch39 coarse M5 sensitivity grid; do not search or tune parameters in this phase.

temporal_and_missingness.split_rule: After a separately accepted disjoint development interval is authorized, split by the UTC-time midpoint of that authorized interval into earlier development and later internal temporal holdout dates before response evaluation; the holdout is not independent confirmation.
temporal_and_missingness.missingness: No fill, interpolation, resampling, synthetic bars, or cross-gap events. Gaps break contiguous segments. Cluster horizons crossing gaps are right-censored and excluded from settled-response estimates while retained in event/censor counts. Do not impute symbols or dates.

data_boundary.accepted_inventory_scope: The bounded Epoch40/Epoch41 inventories report 45 identities with verified M5 bars; they explicitly do not establish absence in other accepted capture scopes.
data_boundary.later_data_authority: A later prospective decision must first audit exact accepted capture scopes and, only if justified, define a minimal disjoint data increment. Do not reuse a collector frozen for another symbol/window scope.
